primary_selection_rule: Select the first policy-eligible full-route checkpoint that satisfies provenance, feature-audit, Docker preflight, and no-held-out-selection gates. If the exact non-averaged BLIP route has documented OOM failures and no checkpoint, select the best full avg-BLIP variant by Open3DSG train-dev val/loss and label every downstream table as an averaged-BLIP Open3DSG variant. Do not choose among checkpoints using H001 held-out metric results.
reselection_rule: Changing the primary checkpoint after H001 held-out metric inspection requires a new schema version and must be reported as a deviation.

route_priority.rule: primary checkpoint if full route completes after official BLIP TopK5/scales3 feature audit pass
select only as an explicitly labeled averaged-BLIP Open3DSG variant after full-route training completes and the non-averaged route has no checkpoint
valid checkpoint-smoke evidence and provenance seed; not final paper-result evidence
fallback for debugging/reporting progress; not final paper result unless full route is explicitly abandoned and claim is downgraded
may validate plumbing only; never promote to paper-result evidence

allowed_selection_signals: training-internal train/validation logs that do not include H001 held-out scans
forbidden_selection_signals: visual inspection of H001 held-out Open3DSG predictions
